game_start.intro: Mweshi wa michezo unatangaza. Mweshi wa kushinda: {trump_suit} (kadi ya kushinda: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} katika Whist ya Kijerumani.
{phase_info}
Una kadi {hand_size} mkononi.
Cheza kadi kwa kutumia '[play N]', ambapo N ni nafasi yake katika mkono wako (kwa mfano '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: TSHITATU tshia dilonga: muntu udi mutshimune mu diteta dionso, utu wangata karte kadi ne mpala kuulu eku mubengianganyi uwangata kaarte kakuabu.
player_prompt.phase_playing: Tshikondo tshia kunaya: tshiamu etshi ntshijike, bualu bua ku mpindieu tshingoma tshionso tshidi ne mushinga wa bungi.

next_card.playing_phase: Kakuena karte to - dikasa dia manaya ndianji kutuadija.
next_card.deck_empty: Tshimfuanyi etshi katshiena ne tshintu to.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dienza dia tshianana. Utela '[play N]' bua kuimbila karte ka Nth mu bianza biebe.
invalid_move.bad_position: Kadi ka muaba aku kadipu to. Udi ne karte {hand_size} (kabayi muinshi mua 0).
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Udi ne bua kulonda tshilejilu tshiende, kuela karte ka {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Kadi aka katuena mua kukapeta to.

trick.won: Muena manaya {winner_id} udi upeta tshiamu ne {card}.
trick.won_learning: Mchezaji {winner_id} anashinda mchezo kwa {card} na kuchukua kadi iliyo wazi.

phase.learning_complete: Tshitupa tshia dilongesha ntshipite, bualu mayele onso adi ashala ne mushinga bua kutshimuna.

draw.loser_received: Wewe mutapike ne mupatule {card} ku tshibambalu.
draw.winner_preview: Kadi ka ndekelu kadibu bateka nku {card}.

turn.scores_learning: Michezo iliyoshinda hadi sasa - Mchezaji 0: {tricks0}, Mchezaji 1: {tricks1}

trick_view.empty: Hakuna kadi zilizochewa bado katika mchezo huu.
